name: literature_review
description: Find and read papers, survey sources, and explicitly discover/import missing papers. capabilities lists contracts; corpora/status/sources inspect coverage; search queries the graph; paper reads source evidence. For method genealogy, lineage_extract reads each selected full text once and caches methods, variants and relation candidates by source version; lineage_status reads progress and token usage; lineage_card reads exact evidence and freshness. lineage_refine independently reviews candidates and can supplement missing sources within explicit cumulative budgets; lineage_refine_status is read-only. lineage_publish previews by default and writes supported current relations only with apply=true; revoke withdraws that publication. Model review does not establish scientific validity. discover/import submit jobs; their status/report operations reconcile existing jobs. Use fast-md-structural imports for materialized Markdown before lineage_extract. field_research runs bounded discovery plus general semantic extraction; batch completion is separate from field coverage. study_save/study/studies manage reviewed scopes and native Web maps. Batch and overview responses default to compact summaries; exact evidence reads retain full detail.

corpus.description: Corpus name or indexed root. Use literature_review/corpora when unknown.

responseMode.description: Batch, search and overview operations default to summary. Exact paper, lineage_card, method/evidence/path and capability reads default to full. Explicit full preserves backend output.

query.description: Research topic, question, or exact node anchor.

sortBy.description: Committed search ranking; defaults to relevance.

identifier.description: Exact paper identifier such as DOI or arXiv id.

chunkLimit.description: Maximum source chunks in a paper view.

sourceKey.description: Exact active source key; required when source selection is ambiguous.

papers.description: Papers for source-versioned lineage evidence cards. Reuses completed cards before calling the configured model.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable id for an import submission; reuse to avoid duplicate async jobs.

retryFailed.description: Explicitly retry only failed or unprocessed entries in an existing lineage run. Completed cards are preserved.

dryRun.description: Preview field research scope and worker readiness without searching, downloading, importing or creating a run.

cardId.description: Exact card id returned by lineage_status.

maxQueries.description: Cumulative gap search budget; default 0. Each query uses one configured provider.

maxNewPapers.description: Cumulative new paper import budget; default 0. Set with maxQueries to enable supplementation.

requestId.description: Stable publication request id. Reuse it to reconcile publication or revocation.

apply.description: Publish or revoke the reviewed relationships. False by default: read-only preview.

revoke.description: Revoke the publication identified by runId and requestId; requires apply=true to change the graph.

targetDomain.description: Target research domain; generate uses cross-domain catalyst when supplied.

constraints.description: Free-text source-review conditions; structured method requirements belong to lineage_analysis/overview or problem.

maxDepth.description: Bounded graph traversal depth, default 2; never global frontier proof.

maxNodes.description: Node budget, default 180. Landscape applies this separately to methods and papers.

maxEdges.description: Edge budget, default 350. Landscape applies this separately to method and paper relations.

expectedRevision.description: Read-back study revision; use 0 to create.

study.description: Field scope, branch reviews, search records and paper/method selection. Saving does not mutate graph evidence.

branchId.description: Optional branch within a saved field study.

discoveryMode.description: search finds metadata; resolve/run can fetch full text. Submitted asynchronously; never imports automatically.

serverFilePath.description: Already staged server-side PDF/Markdown file to import.

doi.description: Optional DOI for an imported source.

arxivId.description: Optional arXiv id for an imported source.

processingProfile.description: fast-md-structural indexes already-materialized Markdown without generic LLM extraction; use before lineage_extract. full runs the general semantic pipeline.

completionPolicy.description: Import completion target. Use graph-visible with fast imports, then review lineage cards separately.

jobId.description: Durable asynchronous import submission job id.

taskId.description: Import task id from the authoritative queue.

taskIds.description: Import task ids from a saved discovery run.

name: lineage_analysis
description: Analyze research evolution from committed evidence: landscape builds a field timeline of papers and methods, connected families, structural mainlines and turning-point candidates with source evidence and coverage limits; overview maps a bounded topic graph; problem gives dated problem observations; method traces validated method lineage; evidence checks method-edge quotes; path/context/impact inspect graph connections. A graph path is not causal proof, and bounded endpoints are not global frontiers. Use literature_review for missing papers and idea_generation for proposals.

name: idea_generation
description: Generate and evaluate research hypotheses from committed sources: generate returns graph candidates (cross-domain catalyst if targetDomain is given), with scoped experimental feedback when project is supplied. diverge/converge explore or focus; gaps separates structural gaps. evaluate defaults to novelty_audit with query/candidateMechanism; mechanism_diagnosis and performance_validation require project/actionId and read a registered action. Design readiness is not execution authorization. experiment_materials returns evidence/cost anchors. No live discovery, graph writeback, or controller execution. Candidates and novelty audits do not prove novelty or gains.
